# APIfootball

> > Football data REST API providing real-time livescores, statistics, and comprehensive coverage of leagues worldwide with JSON responses.

APIfootball offers a complete football data feed API with support for JSON, PHP, and cURL integration. The service covers major European leagues including Premier League, La Liga, and Copa del Rey, with extensive documentation for developers.

## Key Topics

- REST API
- JSON responses
- Football livescore data
- League statistics
- Premier League
- La Liga
- Copa del Rey
- GET endpoints
- PHP integration
- cURL examples
- Widget integration
- European football coverage
- Real-time data feed
- API documentation
- Sports data API

## API Documentation

- [In-Depth Documentation for Football Data Integration - APIfootball](https://apifootball.com/documentation): Main documentation for APIfootball REST API with JSON, PHP, and cURL examples
- [APIfootball - Documentation](https://apifootball.com/documentation-v1): API v1 reference for football livescore endpoints and JSON responses
- [Widgets Documentation for Dynamic Football Data Integration - APIfootball](https://apifootball.com/widgets-documentation): Widget integration guide for jQuery-based livescore and league displays

## Coverage & Features

- [Extensive Coverage of Football Data and Statistics - APIfootball](https://apifootball.com/coverage): Coverage overview of leagues, statistics, and worldwide data plans
